title: Food Packages Delivered to Conflict-Affected Patients in Wad Medani, Sudan
excerpt: Relawan Nusantara delivered 100 ready-to-eat meal packages to displaced people and patients who are victims of the conflict at Wad Medani Teaching Hospital, Sudan. Read their story!
seoTitle: Meals for Conflict-Affected Patients in Sudan - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: Relawan Nusantara delivered 100 ready-to-eat meal packages to displaced people and conflict-affected patients at Wad Medani Teaching Hospital, Sudan.
html:
The prolonged armed conflict in Sudan has forced millions of people to leave their homes in search of refuge in safer areas. One of the destinations for those displaced is Wad Medani, Al-Jazirah State, which now shelters people who have fled the capital, Khartoum.

The growing number of displaced people has also increased the need for health services in the area. Hospitals have become one of the places taking in patients wounded in the war, displaced residents, and people with medical conditions that require special care.

Amid this situation, entrusted by its donors, Relawan Nusantara delivered 100 ready-to-eat meal packages (hot meals) to conflict-affected patients at Wad Medani Teaching Hospital, Al-Jazirah State, Sudan. This assistance is an expression of the care of the Indonesian people, helping to meet the food needs of patients during their treatment.

Food Assistance for Patients Affected by the Sudan Conflict

This food assistance targets patients wounded in the war, displaced residents, and patients with special medical conditions who need extra attention in meeting their food needs.

The majority of beneficiaries are people who were forced to leave Khartoum because of the conflict and sought refuge in Wad Medani. Living in displacement and with limited access to basic necessities, ready-to-eat meals are one of the important forms of support for them during their treatment.

The distribution of these 100 meal packages is expected to help ease patients’ daily needs while showing care for the people of Sudan who are facing a difficult situation.

Bringing the Care of the Indonesian People to Sudan

For communities affected by conflict, humanitarian aid is not merely about meeting basic needs; it is also a reminder that they are not alone in facing hard times.

Through this distribution, Relawan Nusantara strives to bring the care of the Indonesian people to our brothers and sisters in Sudan. It is hoped that this trust of kindness will bring benefit and strengthen those who are struggling through a humanitarian crisis.

Relawan Nusantara is committed to continuing to deliver humanitarian aid to communities in need, including those affected by conflict in various parts of the world.

Together, let us bring smiles back to the land of Sudan. Share your best care, friends, through the Sedekah Air & Pangan untuk Sudan (Water & Food Alms for Sudan) program. From Indonesia, compassion keeps moving to bring hope to others.

Luaskan Manfaat
